migrationArchive.header.title: Clinic archive
migrationArchive.header.description: Source-attributed history from a prior system. These records support clinical and business context, but they do not silently create live appointments, dispense inventory, change accounts receivable, or authorize client communication.
migrationArchive.guide.title: Data validation guide
migrationArchive.guide.description: Work through a small, representative sample before relying on the imported history. Your checklist stays in this browser session and is never written to clinic records.
migrationArchive.guide.stepTotalsDetail: Check that the client, patient, reminder, service, and product counts look plausible.
migrationArchive.guide.stepKnownRecordsT: Find a few familiar clients and patients
migrationArchive.guide.stepKnownRecordsD: Use search and open several records you know well. Confirm identity and relationships before clinical use.
migrationArchive.guide.stepCareHistoryDe: Sample prior appointments, prescriptions, fills, lab reports, and reminders across different years.
migrationArchive.guide.stepBusinessHisto: Sample historical documents and financial records. These are reference history, not live receivables.
migrationArchive.guide.stepExceptionsDet: Check a few familiar examples. OpenVPM remains responsible for the bulk reconciliation queue.
migrationArchive.guide.issueDescription: Copy a privacy-safe report outline. Use only the OpenVPM record reference—never paste names, contact information, medical detail, or old-system identifiers into email or chat.
migrationArchive.guide.issueDisclaimer: Completing this checklist records no approval and never releases protected review mode.
migrationArchive.snapshot.title: Practice data snapshot
migrationArchive.snapshot.description: Use these totals as a reasonableness check, then sample the records below.

migrationArchive.detail.unstructuredLabN: The source supplied this as an unstructured report. Its verified document is preserved separately.
migrationArchive.behavior.title: How imported records behave
migrationArchive.behavior.readyAsHistory: Prior appointments, prescriptions, fills, lab reports, and financial documents are searchable reference records. They do not become upcoming visits, active prescriptions, or current receivables.
migrationArchive.behavior.reviewBeforeRe: Items marked Needs review lack an exact source relationship. Verify the clinic, client, or patient match before using them for care or business decisions.
migrationArchive.behavior.neverRestoredA: Staff access, passwords, messaging consent, send queues, accounts-receivable balances, and stock counts require a fresh OpenVPM decision or reviewed opening value.

settings.data.restoreDescription: Restore structured data into an empty practice. Existing clients, patients, appointments, or invoices block the restore. A backup with attachment manifests must target its original practice.
settings.data.restoreInfo: OpenVPM first checks the backup sections, row counts, and internal record links. Restores are non-destructive and only insert rows that do not already exist.
settings.data.importDescription: Transitioning from another system? Import clients first, then patients, vaccination history, and finally medical history (visits). Each file is checked in a dry run first so you can see duplicates and missing records before anything is saved. Common column names from AVImark, Cornerstone, and ezyVet are recognized. Shepherd migrations are accompanied to verify the exact clinic export format. Owner and patient IDs stay linked across files, even when an owner has no email.

settings.booking.title: Online Appointment Requests
settings.booking.description: Give new and existing clients a simple way to request a preferred appointment time. Every request lands on your schedule for your team to review, assign, and confirm. Share the link, print the QR code, or add the button to your website.
settings.booking.requestHoursDescription: When clients can request times online. Uses your practice timezone.
settings.booking.requestableTypesDescrip: Select each active visit type clients may request online. The public page stays unavailable until at least one type is selected.
settings.booking.intakeFieldsDescription: Selected fields appear on the public appointment request. Responses remain owner-reported and do not overwrite saved client or patient information.
settings.booking.intakeFieldsOptional: All fields are optional. Leave every field unchecked to hide this section from the public request form.
settings.booking.letNewClientsDescriptio: New clients and their pets are added to your records automatically.
settings.booking.neverAutoConfirmed: Requests are never confirmed automatically. Your team reviews the requested time, assigns a doctor and room as needed, and confirms it from the schedule.
settings.booking.welcomeMessageDescripti: A short hello shown at the top of your page

settings.booking.fieldAllergiesDescripti: Include medications, vaccines, foods, or other reactions
settings.booking.fieldMedicalHistoryDesc: Previous diagnoses, procedures, or similar episodes
settings.booking.fieldDietDescription: Food, grazing, recent changes, or possible exposures
settings.booking.fieldHandlingDescriptio: Temperament, restraint needs, gate directions, or arrival notes
settings.messaging.title: Messaging
settings.messaging.description: Text appointment reminders from each location's own number. Clients who reply land in your inbox; STOP opt-outs are handled automatically.
settings.messaging.autoRemindersDescript: Send one reminder for each confirmed appointment. Delivery follows the client's saved reminder preference. Texts require recorded consent and an active clinic number; suppressed email addresses stay blocked.
settings.messaging.offByDefault: Off by default. No automatic appointment reminders are sent until a clinic administrator enables them here. Enabling reminders or increasing this window may send reminders for existing eligible confirmed appointments on the next hourly run.
settings.messaging.textingNotSetup: Texting is not set up yet
settings.messaging.numberSetupDisabled: Number setup is disabled by your OpenVPM administrator. Email reminders can be used now.

vetIntel.item1.title: Emergency measures: Rabies and carnivore vaccination
vetIntel.item1.summary: Mandatory antirabies vaccination of dogs, cats and ferrets under § 17 of Act No. 39/2007 Z. z. Report any suspicion and human bite to the relevant RVPS within 3 working days.
vetIntel.item2.title: African Swine Fever (ASF) – Restriction zone update
vetIntel.item2.summary: Update of protection and surveillance zones in eastern and southern Slovakia. Ban on movement of susceptible animals without veterinary accompanying document.
vetIntel.item3.title: Directive on keeping a narcotics and psychotropic substances register in practice

vetIntel.item4.title: Safety notice: Withdrawal periods in food-producing animals
vetIntel.item4.summary: Strict compliance with and recording of withdrawal periods (meat, milk) when administering registered VMPs. Mandatory entry in the Veterinary Procedures Diary.
vetIntel.item5.title: Seasonal incidence of Babesiosis and tick-borne encephalitis in western and southern SR
vetIntel.item5.summary: Increased detection of Babesia canis transmitted by Dermacentor reticulatus. Recommended early blood smear examination and PCR diagnostics in hyperthermia and splenomegaly.
